verses.1: And you, son of man, who was brought down to the mountains of Israel, you said, “O mountains of Israel, listen to the words of Jehovah.”
verses.2: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: For the evil that those who oppose you have done, they will be punished forever. This is what happened to us.
verses.3: Therefore, it was said, “Thus says the Lord Jehovah: In due time, He will take you away from here, so that you may become a heritage for the nations to come after. Then they will rise up from their graves and speak in human voices.”
verses.4: Therefore, the people of Israel should listen to the words of the Lord Yahweh. He said, “To the mountains and hills, to the valleys and ravines, to the ruined cities that have been abandoned, and to those cities that were once inhabited but now lie in ruins—all these will be destroyed.”
verses.5: Therefore, as Adonai Yehovah said, “If it were not for my jealousy, I would have spoken about the rest of the nations and about Adam alone. But I gave their land to them as a possession, with joy in every heart, so that they might be destroyed.”
verses.6: Therefore, it was announced upon the land of Israel. You said to the mountains and hills, “Be silent!” To the valleys and ravines, “Shut up!” For I, the Lord God, am in a state of anger and fury. I speak because of the wickedness of the nations.
verses.7: Therefore, thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I will lift up my hand. Otherwise, those nations around you will surely do the same.”
verses.8: And you, sons of Israel, offer your branches to Me, and your fruits shall be a gift to the people of Israel, for they are close to entering into the land.
verses.9: For I am with you, and I have turned to you. You shall be obedient, and you shall be planted in the earth.
verses.10: And I have multiplied your people over all the houses of Israel. All the cities and towns were destroyed, and their structures were demolished.
verses.11: And I have multiplied you in number, both in men and animals. They became numerous and multiplied. I will bring you back to your former state. I will restore you to your former glory. And you shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.12: And I will go to you, O people of Israel. I will take your land and make it my own. You will become their inheritance, and it will never be given back to them again.
verses.13: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: “For I have said to you, ‘You shall eat and fill your stomachs with the food of your people.’ You were once the ruler over your people.”
verses.14: Therefore, man shall not eat anymore, and your people shall not understand anymore. Now, O Lord Jehovah!
verses.15: And I will no longer bring upon you the shame and humiliation of other nations. Do not harm your people anymore. My Lord, please do not let your people be destroyed again.
verses.16: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.17: The children of Adam, who lived in Israel, inhabited their land. They covered it with their footprints and with their waste products. Their paths were like the footprints of those who had lived before them.
verses.18: And I will pour my fire upon them, over the blood that they have shed on the earth. Their wounds will be filled with blood.
verses.19: And he scattered them among the nations, and they wandered in their lands as they wished. And their judges judged them accordingly.
verses.20: And he went to the nations that had come there. He desecrated their holy places, saying to them, “These are the people of Jehovah.” They came from their land.
verses.21: And I weep for my holiness, which was profaned in Israel during the times when those nations came and destroyed it.
verses.22: Therefore, say to the house of Israel: “Thus says the Lord God: I am doing this to the house of Israel, not for your sake. I do this only for my holy place, which you have desecrated when you came there.”
verses.23: And I will sanctify my great name, which you have profaned in those lands. The nations shall know that I am Jehovah. May the Lord Jehovah be glorified through my sanctification among them.
verses.24: And I have taken you from among the nations, and I have gathered you from all the lands. I have brought you into your own land.
verses.25: And I have poured out water that is pure upon you. Thus, you will be cleansed from all your impurities and sins.
verses.26: And I will give you a new heart and a new spirit. I will put them within you. And I will take the old heart of stone out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh instead.
verses.27: And I will give your souls to you. I have done what is written in my laws: you shall follow them, and you shall keep my judgments.
verses.28: And you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your ancestors. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.29: And I have delivered you from all your impurities. I have called upon the Lord, and He has increased your numbers. But I will not give you hunger.
verses.30: And I increased the fruit of the tree, and the yield of the field, so that you would not suffer further from hunger in those lands.
verses.31: And remember your evil ways and your wickedness. Remember also your sins against yourselves, and your harmful actions.
verses.32: I do not do this for your sake. But, O Adonai Yehovah, please know that I am doing this out of love for you. May you be guided along the path of Israel.
verses.33: Thus said Adonai Yehovah on the day of my purification from all your sins: “I will restore the cities and rebuild their ruins.”
verses.34: And the land that was lifeless will be brought under control by those who were once hidden from all eyes.
verses.35: And they said, “The land that was once beautiful and full of life became a desolate place. The cities were destroyed, and the people who lived there died. All was in ruins.”
verses.36: And the nations who remain around you shall know that I, the LORD, have built these ruins. I planted the trees; I created the spirit. I, the LORD, spoke and made it happen.
verses.37: So said Adonai YHWH: “Yet again, I demand that the house of Israel be punished, so that they may be treated like sheep.”
verses.38: Like holy sheep in Jerusalem’s courtyards, so too shall the destroyed cities be filled with human beings. They will know that I am Jehovah.
